R1 (T45): a creator who may not see the action is passed over, and a hidden owner's project goes to its own owners
R1 (T45): one item per fact: an entry an adopted duty's Noticed item stands for raises none; the steps standing for an entry are named on its one item
R1 (T45): the item goes to the member who last took the entry up, else its creator, each while an active member who may see the action; else the project's active owners; else the administrators

R1: one CONDITION per overdue clock entry action-clocks answers the viewer, keyed CONDITION::action-clock-overdue::<action>::<position>, to its creator, else the project's owners, else the administrators
R10: one OBLIGATION watch-keep-or-stop per due link, to its recipients alone, homed under the plan's project; a relied-on watch has no door (control: no entry, no item)
R11: each Action-layer kind's options lead with its doors, in order, before queue's acts; a kind outside R11 (R8's finding) has none of them; nothing offers to mark it resolved

R12: plan-review-due, one per review day a member-set rhythm reaches, and plan-look-again, one per paused plan whose day has come; due and age in the instance profile's zone; a recorded review removes it (control: no rhythm, no item)

R13, R25: actionItems answers every kind R1–R12 and R25 derive, with facts stating each producer's bound; no item carries disposition or catalogue_id; a provider that throws is named in facts.failed and the rest stand; it writes nothing
R14: no answer names a bundle the viewer may not see, and no count reveals one
R15, R25: a CONDITION earns an item only where a member's act can change it: each CONDITION kind offers the acts that answer it
R16: no place is named in this module's behaviour or outward text

R1 (T45): a creator who may not see the action is passed over, and a hidden owner's project goes to its own owners

R1 (T45; v0.2 rule 6), R23: the words by basis, read by key: the addressee's date is canon's question; the group's own and the other side's stated dates read words.json's keys; none says overdue, violation or legal
R2, R3, R7 (T45): their recipients follow R1's rule
R3 (T45): a stopped_pursuing escalation proposes no edge and raises no item; the control, an open one, does
R4 (T45): a reminder raises an item only while its setter is an active member who may see the action, and then goes to nobody else

R5 (T45; v0.2 rule 12): a docket legal mark and a legal pressure record raise one item each, keyed by where they arrived; placing the hold removes it; an action's mark and a docket mark on one matter are two items

R9: leaving one project names only that project's items; items of no project go to the administrators under none
R11: each Action-layer kind's options lead with its doors, in order, before queue's acts; a kind outside R11 (R8's finding) has none of them; nothing offers to mark it resolved

R15, R25: a CONDITION earns an item only where a member's act can change it: each CONDITION kind offers the acts that answer it
R16: no place is named in this module's behaviour or outward text

tests: R1: one CONDITION per overdue clock entry action-clocks answers the viewer, keyed CONDITION::action-clock-overdue::<action>::<position>, to its creator, else the project's owners, else the administrators

R2: one OBLIGATION per checkpoint action-plans answers due, keyed OBLIGATION::plan-checkpoint-due::<plan>::<scenario>::<phase>, to the member who set the scenario, else the owners, else the administrators; never a FINDING or a CONDITION

R3: one OBLIGATION per (escalation, proposed edge) escalation answers the viewer, keyed OBLIGATION::escalation-stage-proposed::<escalation>::<to>, to its opener, else the owners, else the administrators, aged from the trigger's instant

R4: one OBLIGATION per reminder action-clocks answers due, keyed OBLIGATION::action-reminder::<action>::<position>::<on>, to the member who set it and to nobody else, offering another reminder or none

R5: one OBLIGATION litigation-hold per legal mark action-holds.holdsDue answers the viewer, keyed OBLIGATION::litigation-hold::<action>::<position>, to every administrator and the marker and nobody else, until a hold is stated
R18 (DEC-110 (1)): action-clock-overdue and action-reminder carry the clock entry's date as due, plan-checkpoint-due the checkpoint's, YYYY-MM-DD; an unreadable date carries null

R8 (DEC-113): one FINDING litigation-hold-released per release action-holds.holdsReleased answers the viewer, keyed FINDING::litigation-hold-released::<action>::<position>::<sequence>, to every administrator and each member among its placers and nobody else, raised once
R26: every item names an action by its title, never its id: the legal-threat, reminder, released-hold and local-fact items; an action with no title is named by the module's fallback
R1 (T45): the item goes to the member who last took the entry up, else its creator, each while an active member who may see the action; else the project's active owners; else the administrators
R1 (T45): a creator who may not see the action is passed over, and a hidden owner's project goes to its own owners
R1 (T45): one item per fact: an entry an adopted duty's Noticed item stands for raises none; the steps standing for an entry are named on its one item

R1 (T45; v0.2 rule 6), R23: the words by basis, read by key: the addressee's date is canon's question; the group's own and the other side's stated dates read words.json's keys; none says overdue, violation or legal
R2, R3, R7 (T45): their recipients follow R1's rule
R3 (T45): a stopped_pursuing escalation proposes no edge and raises no item; the control, an open one, does
R4 (T45): a reminder raises an item only while its setter is an active member who may see the action, and then goes to nobody else

R5 (T45; v0.2 rule 12): a docket legal mark and a legal pressure record raise one item each, keyed by where they arrived; placing the hold removes it; an action's mark and a docket mark on one matter are two items

R9: leaving one project names only that project's items; items of no project go to the administrators under none
R9, R14: an item in a project the owner may not see is neither named nor counted

R5 (T45; v0.2 rule 12): a docket legal mark and a legal pressure record raise one item each, keyed by where they arrived; placing the hold removes it; an action's mark and a docket mark on one matter are two items

R9: a revoked creator's entries are named to the project's owners in one item, with a take-up door on each; she is never told; an item another member took up is not named (control: while she is active, none)
R9: leaving one project names only that project's items; items of no project go to the administrators under none
R9, R14: an item in a project the owner may not see is neither named nor counted
R10: one OBLIGATION watch-keep-or-stop per due link, to its recipients alone, homed under the plan's project; a relied-on watch has no door (control: no entry, no item)

R15, R25: a CONDITION earns an item only where a member's act can change it: each CONDITION kind offers the acts that answer it

R3: one OBLIGATION per (escalation, proposed edge) escalation answers the viewer, keyed OBLIGATION::escalation-stage-proposed::<escalation>::<to>, to its opener, else the owners, else the administrators, aged from the trigger's instant

R4: one OBLIGATION per reminder action-clocks answers due, keyed OBLIGATION::action-reminder::<action>::<position>::<on>, to the member who set it and to nobody else, offering another reminder or none

R5: one OBLIGATION litigation-hold per legal mark action-holds.holdsDue answers the viewer, keyed OBLIGATION::litigation-hold::<action>::<position>, to every administrator and the marker and nobody else, until a hold is stated
R18 (DEC-110 (1)): action-clock-overdue and action-reminder carry the clock entry's date as due, plan-checkpoint-due the checkpoint's, YYYY-MM-DD; an unreadable date carries null

R8 (DEC-113): one FINDING litigation-hold-released per release action-holds.holdsReleased answers the viewer, keyed FINDING::litigation-hold-released::<action>::<position>::<sequence>, to every administrator and each member among its placers and nobody else, raised once
R26: every item names an action by its title, never its id: the legal-threat, reminder, released-hold and local-fact items; an action with no title is named by the module's fallback
R13: the actionItems fixture answers the real read: one item to the member who created the action, none to a member who sees nothing, each beside its facts
R20: west of UTC at the day boundary, every day this module derives is the local day in the subject's zone, never the UTC day
R18: an item's due is the local day in the subject's zone, YYYY-MM-DD: the clock entry's date as the action's local day, a checkpoint's instant read on its local day
R20: with no zone held, the day and the age are undetermined, stated, never computed on UTC
R1 (K1658): the overdue item states action-clocks' local day and the entry's basis kind, and counts the entries left out for want of a zone across every page read
R1, R4 (N609; K1675): each item's days are read in its own zone as action-clocks carries it, else in actions' zone; the zone is stated
R1 (T45): the item goes to the member who last took the entry up, else its creator, each while an active member who may see the action; else the project's active owners; else the administrators
R1 (T45): a creator who may not see the action is passed over, and a hidden owner's project goes to its own owners
R1 (T45): one item per fact: an entry an adopted duty's Noticed item stands for raises none; the steps standing for an entry are named on its one item

R1 (T45; v0.2 rule 6), R23: the words by basis, read by key: the addressee's date is canon's question; the group's own and the other side's stated dates read words.json's keys; none says overdue, violation or legal
R2, R3, R7 (T45): their recipients follow R1's rule
R3 (T45): a stopped_pursuing escalation proposes no edge and raises no item; the control, an open one, does
R4 (T45): a reminder raises an item only while its setter is an active member who may see the action, and then goes to nobody else

R5 (T45; v0.2 rule 12): a docket legal mark and a legal pressure record raise one item each, keyed by where they arrived; placing the hold removes it; an action's mark and a docket mark on one matter are two items

R9: a revoked creator's entries are named to the project's owners in one item, with a take-up door on each; she is never told; an item another member took up is not named (control: while she is active, none)
R9: leaving one project names only that project's items; items of no project go to the administrators under none
R9, R14: an item in a project the owner may not see is neither named nor counted
R10: one OBLIGATION watch-keep-or-stop per due link, to its recipients alone, homed under the plan's project; a relied-on watch has no door (control: no entry, no item)

R12: plan-review-due, one per review day a member-set rhythm reaches, and plan-look-again, one per paused plan whose day has come; due and age in the instance profile's zone; a recorded review removes it (control: no rhythm, no item)
R11: each Action-layer kind's options lead with its doors, in order, before queue's acts; a kind outside R11 (R8's finding) has none of them; nothing offers to mark it resolved

R13, R25: actionItems answers every kind R1–R12 and R25 derive, with facts stating each producer's bound; no item carries disposition or catalogue_id; a provider that throws is named in facts.failed and the rest stand; it writes nothing
R14: no answer names a bundle the viewer may not see, and no count reveals one
R15, R25: a CONDITION earns an item only where a member's act can change it: each CONDITION kind offers the acts that answer it
R16: no place is named in this module's behaviour or outward text
R17 (DEC-107; DEC-131): no member-facing sentence of any kind says 'obligation', 'condition' or 'signal'; the codes, kinds and ids are unchanged
R18: due is carried by action-clock-overdue, action-reminder, plan-checkpoint-due, plan-review-due and plan-look-again, and by no other item
R19 (DEC-114): no member-facing sentence of any kind calls what an action plan addresses a 'subject'; the item key `subject` is unchanged

R21, R11: R1's item offers actioncorrespond, then the met-or-waived door (the action's revision, op=promote, keyed to the action and the entry, changing only its status to met or waived, labelled door.clockentrystate), then take-up; an entry stated met leaves

R22: an entry carrying noticed_by raises R1's item once its duty's watch has ended (dutyWatchEnd a day before the read's local day), with R1's recipients, key, words and age; while it answers null, today, or throws, none (one fact, one item)
R22, R9: a departed creator's entry a duty's Noticed item stands for is named only once that duty's watch has ended
R23: each item's sentence is its words.json key's words filled from the item's own facts, answered beside its key; the kept sentences answer no key
R23, R11: each door's label is words.json's door.<op> where it holds one; actionholdrelease and factconfirm, which it does not, keep theirs
R23: every sentence this module holds by key is words.json's en, verbatim, but canon's question R23 keeps unchanged; the kept sentences are named

R24: the group's own date owed to an office answers queue.action-clock-overdue.ours.detail naming the office as its role and body, a venue by its name, {what} and {date} as the summary fills them (control: no office or venue held keeps the present detail and no detail_key)
R24: a plan's review reads queue.plan-review-due.detail naming the plan's title, its rhythm in words and the last review's day (control: a plan never reviewed names the day its rhythm was set)
R24: a rhythm not one occurrence a period, an unreadable one, or no day since keeps the plan review's present detail and no detail_key (control: a weekly rhythm on one day is keyed)

R25: one CONDITION request-unsent per filing filings.approvedUnsent answers the viewer, keyed CONDITION::request-unsent::<filing>, to the member who approved it, else the action's creator, else its project's owners (control: while the approver is active, nobody else)
R25: its subject the action, homed under its project, naming what is asked (the action's own title, K3122) and the approval's day; aged from the approval; it carries no due
R25: its doors are the action's screen at its step, queuesnooze and actionmove to abandoned with a reason, in that order, before queue's acts (control: R1's item offers none of them)
R25: it leaves when the filing is recorded sent or the action is dropped (abandoned) or resolved (control: an active action's stands); a filing on an action the viewer may not see is no item (R14)
R25 (K3000): an approver filings answers in the stamped form (member:alice) is that member (control: the bare form)

R6: one OBLIGATION per (version, member) reviewsRequested answers the viewer, keyed OBLIGATION::template-review-requested::<template>@<version>::<member>, to that member and nobody else, until reviewed or out of review
R7: one OBLIGATION per fact factsDue answers over the paths calendarFactsRead answers the viewer, keyed OBLIGATION::local-fact-due::<path>::<status>, to R1's recipients of the actions that read it
R6 (N476): a project template's item is homed under its project, a group template's under none, and a template the viewer may not see yields no item and names nothing

R1 (T45): one item per fact: an entry an adopted duty's Noticed item stands for raises none; the steps standing for an entry are named on its one item

R1 (T45; v0.2 rule 6), R23: the words by basis, read by key: the addressee's date is canon's question; the group's own and the other side's stated dates read words.json's keys; none says overdue, violation or legal
R2, R3, R7 (T45): their recipients follow R1's rule
R3 (T45): a stopped_pursuing escalation proposes no edge and raises no item; the control, an open one, does
R4 (T45): a reminder raises an item only while its setter is an active member who may see the action, and then goes to nobody else

R5 (T45; v0.2 rule 12): a docket legal mark and a legal pressure record raise one item each, keyed by where they arrived; placing the hold removes it; an action's mark and a docket mark on one matter are two items

R9: a revoked creator's entries are named to the project's owners in one item, with a take-up door on each; she is never told; an item another member took up is not named (control: while she is active, none)
R9: leaving one project names only that project's items; items of no project go to the administrators under none
R9, R14: an item in a project the owner may not see is neither named nor counted
R10: one OBLIGATION watch-keep-or-stop per due link, to its recipients alone, homed under the plan's project; a relied-on watch has no door (control: no entry, no item)

R12: plan-review-due, one per review day a member-set rhythm reaches, and plan-look-again, one per paused plan whose day has come; due and age in the instance profile's zone; a recorded review removes it (control: no rhythm, no item)
R11: each Action-layer kind's options lead with its doors, in order, before queue's acts; a kind outside R11 (R8's finding) has none of them; nothing offers to mark it resolved

R13, R25: actionItems answers every kind R1–R12 and R25 derive, with facts stating each producer's bound; no item carries disposition or catalogue_id; a provider that throws is named in facts.failed and the rest stand; it writes nothing
R14: no answer names a bundle the viewer may not see, and no count reveals one
R15, R25: a CONDITION earns an item only where a member's act can change it: each CONDITION kind offers the acts that answer it
R16: no place is named in this module's behaviour or outward text
R17 (DEC-107; DEC-131): no member-facing sentence of any kind says 'obligation', 'condition' or 'signal'; the codes, kinds and ids are unchanged
R18: due is carried by action-clock-overdue, action-reminder, plan-checkpoint-due, plan-review-due and plan-look-again, and by no other item
R19 (DEC-114): no member-facing sentence of any kind calls what an action plan addresses a 'subject'; the item key `subject` is unchanged

R21, R11: R1's item offers actioncorrespond, then the met-or-waived door (the action's revision, op=promote, keyed to the action and the entry, changing only its status to met or waived, labelled door.clockentrystate), then take-up; an entry stated met leaves

R22: an entry carrying noticed_by raises R1's item once its duty's watch has ended (dutyWatchEnd a day before the read's local day), with R1's recipients, key, words and age; while it answers null, today, or throws, none (one fact, one item)
R22, R9: a departed creator's entry a duty's Noticed item stands for is named only once that duty's watch has ended
R23: each item's sentence is its words.json key's words filled from the item's own facts, answered beside its key; the kept sentences answer no key
R23, R11: each door's label is words.json's door.<op> where it holds one; actionholdrelease and factconfirm, which it does not, keep theirs
R23: every sentence this module holds by key is words.json's en, verbatim, but canon's question R23 keeps unchanged; the kept sentences are named

R24: the group's own date owed to an office answers queue.action-clock-overdue.ours.detail naming the office as its role and body, a venue by its name, {what} and {date} as the summary fills them (control: no office or venue held keeps the present detail and no detail_key)
R24: a plan's review reads queue.plan-review-due.detail naming the plan's title, its rhythm in words and the last review's day (control: a plan never reviewed names the day its rhythm was set)
R24: a rhythm not one occurrence a period, an unreadable one, or no day since keeps the plan review's present detail and no detail_key (control: a weekly rhythm on one day is keyed)

R25: one CONDITION request-unsent per filing filings.approvedUnsent answers the viewer, keyed CONDITION::request-unsent::<filing>, to the member who approved it, else the action's creator, else its project's owners (control: while the approver is active, nobody else)
R25: its subject the action, homed under its project, naming what is asked (the action's own title, K3122) and the approval's day; aged from the approval; it carries no due
R25: its doors are the action's screen at its step, queuesnooze and actionmove to abandoned with a reason, in that order, before queue's acts (control: R1's item offers none of them)
R25: it leaves when the filing is recorded sent or the action is dropped (abandoned) or resolved (control: an active action's stands); a filing on an action the viewer may not see is no item (R14)
R25 (K3000): an approver filings answers in the stamped form (member:alice) is that member (control: the bare form)

R6: one OBLIGATION per (version, member) reviewsRequested answers the viewer, keyed OBLIGATION::template-review-requested::<template>@<version>::<member>, to that member and nobody else, until reviewed or out of review
R7: one OBLIGATION per fact factsDue answers over the paths calendarFactsRead answers the viewer, keyed OBLIGATION::local-fact-due::<path>::<status>, to R1's recipients of the actions that read it
R6 (N476): a project template's item is homed under its project, a group template's under none, and a template the viewer may not see yields no item and names nothing

R1 (T45): the item goes to the member who last took the entry up, else its creator, each while an active member who may see the action; else the project's active owners; else the administrators
R1 (T45): a creator who may not see the action is passed over, and a hidden owner's project goes to its own owners
R1 (T45): one item per fact: an entry an adopted duty's Noticed item stands for raises none; the steps standing for an entry are named on its one item

R1 (T45; v0.2 rule 6), R23: the words by basis, read by key: the addressee's date is canon's question; the group's own and the other side's stated dates read words.json's keys; none says overdue, violation or legal
R2, R3, R7 (T45): their recipients follow R1's rule
R3 (T45): a stopped_pursuing escalation proposes no edge and raises no item; the control, an open one, does
R4 (T45): a reminder raises an item only while its setter is an active member who may see the action, and then goes to nobody else

R5 (T45; v0.2 rule 12): a docket legal mark and a legal pressure record raise one item each, keyed by where they arrived; placing the hold removes it; an action's mark and a docket mark on one matter are two items

R9: a revoked creator's entries are named to the project's owners in one item, with a take-up door on each; she is never told; an item another member took up is not named (control: while she is active, none)
R9: leaving one project names only that project's items; items of no project go to the administrators under none
R9, R14: an item in a project the owner may not see is neither named nor counted
R10: one OBLIGATION watch-keep-or-stop per due link, to its recipients alone, homed under the plan's project; a relied-on watch has no door (control: no entry, no item)

R12: plan-review-due, one per review day a member-set rhythm reaches, and plan-look-again, one per paused plan whose day has come; due and age in the instance profile's zone; a recorded review removes it (control: no rhythm, no item)
R11: each Action-layer kind's options lead with its doors, in order, before queue's acts; a kind outside R11 (R8's finding) has none of them; nothing offers to mark it resolved

R13, R25: actionItems answers every kind R1–R12 and R25 derive, with facts stating each producer's bound; no item carries disposition or catalogue_id; a provider that throws is named in facts.failed and the rest stand; it writes nothing
R14: no answer names a bundle the viewer may not see, and no count reveals one
R15, R25: a CONDITION earns an item only where a member's act can change it: each CONDITION kind offers the acts that answer it

R18: due is carried by action-clock-overdue, action-reminder, plan-checkpoint-due, plan-review-due and plan-look-again, and by no other item
